announced.basis: documents this watch saw appear between one run and the next. Everything present when the watch was seeded is deliberately absent here: it was already known and was never new.

as_of_means: The date of the last live crawl, not today. This feed goes visibly out of date rather than silently.

awaiting_minutes.basis: an agenda posted for a past date whose file id has no minutes alongside it in the town's listing. This is minutes against AGENDAS, not against meetings held -- the same proxy sources/data/minutes-coverage.csv rests on, and the town publishes nothing that reconciles the two.

first_seen_means: The day our crawler first saw a document. The town publishes no posting timestamp, so a gap between a meeting and its minutes appearing is an UPPER BOUND on how long the town took, never a measurement of it. Documents adopted when the watch was seeded have no first_seen and are excluded from every lag figure.
not_a_measurement: This file records what the Lunenburg Budget Project's crawler could see on the town's AgendaCenter on the date given. It is not a figure checked against a document, and it must not be presented beside one as the same kind of number.

recent.basis: one row per meeting from sources/data/meeting-register.csv -- the one record a meeting has -- for past meetings the town posted or published something about in the window; every artifact we hold for it is on the row. Newest activity first.

our_minutes.headline: Committee voted the current town hall (Ritter) building is too small and needs an addition.
Town manager says finance-department transition is causing substantial, monthslong operational and financial disruption
Select Board finished the Nov. 18 special town meeting warrant, including new SAP vacation-bank rules.
The Select Board placed the school district's shortfall articles on the September special town meeting warrant.
The Select Board called a citizen-petition special town meeting for September 3, setting the warrant and hearing schedule.
Appraisal finds the 925 Mass Ave property has a negative value, complicating the town's redevelopment plans
Board took only routine votes; public comment sharply disputed override claims of fire and police service cuts
Public comment turned into a pitched fight over the FY27 override, staffing cuts, and a disputed Ledger story.
Board set the FY27 town meeting warrant and voted a two-tier override question onto the town election ballot
Board included nearly all FY27 warrant articles; TC Passios' safety issues leave the food pantry's future unresolved.
Select Board leaned toward a two-tier (core + restoration) joint town/school override, no vote taken
Board leans toward an FY27 override as the school/town budget gap sits near $3.15 million.
Town manager says the preliminary FY27 budget won't balance and will need an override, projected over $3 million short
Select Board rehired retired town accountant Karen Brochu as interim finance director amid a stalled recruitment.
Board voted 4-1 to send a letter pressing school/finance committees to communicate better ahead of budget season
Select Board voted unanimously to let the town manager sign a low-income community solar discount deal.
Select Board voted a single FY2026 tax rate, rejecting a split rate and all optional exemptions.
Conservation Commission approved the Lake Shirley boat ramp rebuild with wetland buffer waivers.
Task force approved its stormwater warrant article for special town meeting by unanimous roll call.
Trust commission accuses school committee of illegally withholding scholarship fund records; dispute unresolved
Open Space Committee reelected its chair and began rewriting land-acquisition criteria, to return in October
Board withholds releasing a tax lien on a Chapter Land property until the owner pays years of back taxes owed.
Sewer Commission voted to seek a combined multi-year pump station O&M/construction contract for Nov. town meeting
PACC will seek a November special town meeting warrant for more money as FY27 salaries run tight
Council on Aging agreed to pursue a capital-plan funding request for the senior center's parking lot redesign
Personnel Committee unanimously approved the data collector job description as written, unchanged from its 2024 grade.
Paraprofessional contract vote delayed again over salary-calculation errors; two placeholder warrant articles advanced
Select Board advanced the Food Pantry's temporary move to 30 School Street, waiving fees and OK'ing a license.
The school committee will hire its own next business administrator, deciding by vote next week after tonight's public interview.

upcoming.basis: an agenda posted for a date on or after as_of. An agenda is not a guarantee the meeting happens, and a meeting can be held with no agenda posted.
